contexts.text: In Heaven there are changes of heat as to those things which are of the good of love, and of light as to those things which are of the truth of faith; thus changes of love and of faith. In Hell too there are changes, but opposite to the former ones... These changes correspond to the changes of the times of the year on earth, which are spring, summer, autumn, and winter, and then spring again, and so on... These changes are not the same with one as they are with another, but differ with everyone according to the state of life which he has acquired in this world.
Concerning these changes see above. References.
